info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Realestate Listings Agents-v3-spec
info.description: The Real Estate Listings by Agent API provides access to detailed property listings associated with specific real estate agents. This endpoint allows users to retrieve a comprehensive list of available properties, facilitating informed decision-making for potential buyers and investors. Typical consumers include real estate professionals, developers, and buyers seeking to connect with agents and explore available listings. Utilize this API to explore agent-specific real estate offerings efficiently.

get.summary: Retrieve listings associated with a specific agent.
get.description: Fetches a list of real estate listings that are connected to the specified agent, allowing users to view properties represented by that agent.

requestBody.description: Request body for retrieving listings by agent. This body contains the parameters necessary to filter and fetch the relevant data pertaining to the agent's listings.
